tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: List the SoundBoardio boards with their slug, name, language, number of quotes and page url.

tools.name: list_quotes
tools.description: List every quote on one board, each with a url that plays it. Use it when the user only roughly remembers or paraphrases a quote.

tools.name: search_quotes
tools.description: Search quotes on all boards. Every word of the query must appear, in any order; case and diacritics do not matter. Returns the matching quotes, whole-phrase matches first, each with a url that plays it, and the boards whose name matches.

tools.name: validate_board
tools.description: Check a soundboard's soundboardio.json manifest like the SoundBoardio validator does. Give the GitHub repository, or the manifest text to check it before pushing. Returns every check with its status (error, warning, tip or ok), message and line in the manifest, and the board url.
